lesson_ratings.title: # ما بدي الكون فاضي
lesson_ratings.reason: Introduces meaningful vocabulary about rejecting pretense and following the heart, with only one line of filler.

lesson_ratings.title: # رفض المال والمظاهر
lesson_ratings.reason: Teaches useful phrases about refusing money and appearances, though half the lines are onomatopoeia.

lesson_ratings.title: # جوقة: عيش بلا حدود
lesson_ratings.reason: First appearance of the chorus with rich vocabulary on living freely and simply.

lesson_ratings.title: # لا دهب ولا ألماس
lesson_ratings.reason: Contains real words rejecting materialism, but starts and ends with long stretches of nonsense syllables.

lesson_ratings.title: # الإتيكيت والبساطة
lesson_ratings.reason: Teaches words about ignoring etiquette and valuing essence, with only a short filler ending.

lesson_ratings.title: # الختام: عيش بلا حدود (الجزء الأول)
lesson_ratings.reason: Exact reprise of the chorus from lesson 3, adding no new learning.

lesson_ratings.title: # الختام: عيش بلا حدود (الجزء الثاني)
lesson_ratings.reason: Repetition of the first half of the chorus already taught.

lesson_ratings.title: # الختام: عيش بلا حدود (الجزء الثالث)
lesson_ratings.reason: Repetition of the second half of the chorus and more onomatopoeia, no new content.
